import unreal
system_path='/Game/SSPR_Validation/NS_SSPR_ProjTest.NS_SSPR_ProjTest'
system=unreal.load_object(None,system_path)
source=None
for g in unreal.ObjectIterator(unreal.NiagaraDataInterfaceGrid2DCollection):
    if g.get_path_name()==system_path+':NiagaraDataInterfaceGrid2DCollection_0':
        source=g
        break
if system is None or source is None: raise RuntimeError('missing system/source grid')
binding=source.get_editor_property('render_target_user_parameter')
patched=[]
for g in unreal.ObjectIterator(unreal.NiagaraDataInterfaceGrid2DCollection):
    p=g.get_path_name()
    if not p.startswith(system_path+':ProjParticles_0.') or '.Invalidated_' in p:
        continue
    if '.GPUComputeScript.' not in p and '.UpdateScript.' not in p:
        continue
    g.modify()
    g.set_editor_property('num_cells_x',256)
    g.set_editor_property('num_cells_y',256)
    g.set_editor_property('num_cells_max_axis',256)
    g.set_editor_property('set_grid_from_max_axis',False)
    g.set_editor_property('num_attributes',1)
    g.set_editor_property('clear_before_non_iteration_stage',True)
    g.set_editor_property('override_format',False)
    g.set_editor_property('render_target_user_parameter',binding)
    patched.append({'path':p,'x':g.get_editor_property('num_cells_x'),'y':g.get_editor_property('num_cells_y'),'attrs':g.get_editor_property('num_attributes'),'rt':str(g.get_editor_property('render_target_user_parameter').get_editor_property('parameter').get_editor_property('name'))})
system.modify()
unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.save_loaded_asset(system,False)
print('PATCHED_COMPILED_GRIDS='+repr(patched))
if not patched: raise RuntimeError('no active compiled grid defaults found')
del g
del source
del system
